faqs.question: What is a freelance contract?
faqs.answer: A freelance contract is a legal agreement that outlines the terms of a freelance project.

faqs.question: Do freelancers need contracts?
faqs.answer: Contracts help protect both freelancers and clients by clearly defining expectations.

title: Freelance Contract Template for Designers
description: Designer freelance contract template for creative service agreements.
intro: This freelance contract template helps designers set clear expectations for project scope, revisions, timelines, and payment terms.
whenToUse: Use this template before starting a design project or onboarding a new client.
template:
This agreement is between [Client Name] and [Designer Name].

Project scope:
[Describe design services]

Deliverables:
[List final deliverables]

Estimated timeline:
[Dates]

Payment terms:
[Amount and payment schedule]

Revision policy:
[Number of revisions included]
example:
This agreement is between Radiant Interiors and Anna Lee.

Project scope:
Brand identity and website design.

Deliverables:
Logo files, brand guidelines, website mockups.

Estimated timeline:
June 1 to July 15, 2026.

Payment terms:
$4,000 total, 50% due up front and 50% on completion.

Revision policy:
Two rounds of revisions included.
tips: Specify the number of revisions included.
Include payment milestones and due dates.
Clarify ownership of final design files.
Ask the client to sign before beginning work.

faqs.question: Why do designers need a freelance contract?
faqs.answer: A contract protects both the designer and client by defining scope, payment, and responsibilities.

faqs.question: Should I include revision limits?
faqs.answer: Yes—revision limits help prevent scope creep and protect your time.

faqs.question: Can I use this contract for web design?
faqs.answer: Yes, this template works well for branding, web design, and creative services.

title: Freelance Contract Template for Writers

whenToUse: Use this template before beginning writing projects for clients or publishers.

[Describe writing assignment]

Deliverables:

[Delivery dates]

Payment terms:
[Fee and schedule]

Usage rights:
[Who owns the content after delivery]

Payment terms:

Usage rights:
Client receives unlimited use of the final content.
tips: Clearly define the content deliverables and deadlines.
Specify usage rights for the final work.
Include payment terms and milestone schedules.
Ask the client to agree to the terms before starting work.

faqs.question: Does a writer need a freelance contract?
faqs.answer: Yes, it protects both parties and sets expectations for deliverables and payment.

faqs.question: Should content ownership be included?
faqs.answer: Yes, clarify whether the client has exclusive rights or usage permissions.

faqs.question: Can this template be used for copywriting?
